attacks.name: Quantum Sword
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild| or |!block| results to a Blank.

attacks.name: Nega-Quantum Blast Wave
steps: |!wild| |*Incinerate|: After each attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild| or |!block| results to a Blank.

superPowers.name: Charge
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes a move action followed by an attack action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Quantum Bands
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 2 and roll 4 dice. The chosen character loses |!power| equal to the number of |!critical|, |!wild| and |!hit| results. If the chosen character would lose more |!power| than it has, it suffers 1 |!damage| for each |!power| it could not lose. The chosen character does not gain |!power| for |!damage| suffered this way. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Force Field
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by a |!physical| or |!energy| attack, it may use this superpower. Add 2 dice to this character's defense roll against that attack.

superPowers.name: Kree-Titan Hybrid Physiology
superPowers.body: When this character suffers |!damage| from an enemy effect, after the effect is resolved, it may use this superpower. This character removes 1 |!damage| or 1 special condition from itself. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.
